notes.title: Update LIVE + French & Spanish Loc added
notes.notes:
Fellow AnthropomorFANS,

As I already teased last week, the big update has just been released. ːsteamhappyː

Before I get to the changelog, here's a small drawback for the upcoming update; so please read carefully:

This new version is not compatible with older savegames. If you are currently playing through the game, either it with the older version or dive right into the new one.

We've created a beta branch for the game that runs with the old version, just to make sure that everyone that is currently in the middle of a playthrough won't have to start from scratch. Here's how to access the Beta Branch through the Steam Client:

Right-click Beyond the Edge of Owlsgard in your Steam Library and choose Properties
Navigate to the Betas tab
Enter the phrase OwlsgardReleaseBuild to the text box and hit Check Code
Under Beta Participation choose the branch public_rc_old from the dropdown menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41175855/dbfafe664e0c1ff6424188ce2f9ef1f61cb04914.png
Here's the changelog for the update:

 Spanish translation added
 French translation added
 Leftover development message when looking at the robot's drill got removed
 Little adjustments of text position on some scenes for better readability
 Invisible placeholder character removed from pub scene
 Fixed some mixed up text when giving items to NPC
 adjusted multiple walkable areas to prevent player from clipping through certain spots
 Game no longer crashes when leaving with Boleks ship
 Game Over menu can now be navigated on Linux and Steam Deck

Adding new languages to an existing game can be a challenging thing, hence I'm super happy to finally be able to provide you with French and Spanish localizations for you to enjoy.

Have fun everyone and thank you so much for your ongoing support!

notes.title: The release of Owlsgard will be postponed to the end of the year
notes.notes:
Hey retro game fans, owl fanatics and clubmoss lovers!

A quick little update regarding the release date of Owlsgard here!
I already posted something about this on Kickstarter and on the official Twitter account.

To make it short - I sadly needed to postpone the release date to later this year. I really gave 200% to have everything finished for a release this September, but as it often is the case, things need longer than expected. No matter how much time you spend working on a project like this... in the end you always underestimate just how much work it is to finish it all up! ^^"
The last 15% of game development is usually really tough and time-consuming, especially if you develop it all as a single person. The voice acting is still being recorded and implemented, and I still need time for the testing, bugfixing, polishing and the implementation of the multiple translations.

I hope you understand, and I will do my best to hopefully bring you all this game in December! :D

Regards,
Hans
